literal: to-love they-who-experience affection they-are-without they-themselves they-who-love to-love they-experience-not if
translation: Even those who are loved by many are devoid of affection, if they are not loved in return by the one they love.
modern: தாம் விரும்பும் காதலரால் தாம் விரும்பப்படாவிட்டால், உலகத்தாரால் விரும்பப்படுபவர்களும் அன்பில்லாதவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: The speaker reflects on the deep pain of unreciprocated love. Even if a person is loved and admired by the whole world, that widespread admiration feels entirely empty if they are not loved back by the specific person they desire. The word 'கெழீஇ' (affection or union) highlights that true emotional fulfillment only comes from mutual love, making any other affection meaningless.
